title: J2 compact flange geometry — Gate04D-C2
status: C2 REJECTED BY INTERFERENCE / C2R1 ACTIVE STUDY
requirement_problem: Reduce OD36 bulk without losing serviceability, seal architecture, datum functions, manufacturability or robustness.
selected_study_alternative: C2R1 round OD33 / 3×M2.5 / PCD26.5 / pilot OD14.10 ID12.00 L1.50

functional_requirement.note: OD33 C2 preserves removable J2, L35, Ø14.10 pilot and current seal architecture.

architecture_integrity.note: No weld; serviceable P003↔P007 concept retained.

interfaces_datums.note: C2 assembly mate architecture passed, but C2R1 changes P003 pilot topology; rerun native build/verify before carrying this gate forward.

load_cases.note: Pressure case exists; seal/preload/service/thermal load envelope not fully bounded.

static_strength_contact.note: Preliminary M2.5/thread screen does not reject the concept; exact preload and local flange/contact verification remain open.

buckling_stability.note: Historical P007 result must be refreshed after final C2 flange freeze.

torsion_rotational.note: Clocking geometry works; torque reaction/loosening/service strategy open.

thermal.note: 316L/316L match helps; O-ring and screw/preload temperature behavior open.

pressure_vacuum_sealing.note: Gland geometry controlled; compound/compression force/leak test open.

fluid_cfd.note: C2 changes external flange/fastener package; controlled sample-flow geometry is unchanged.

magnetic_electromagnetic.note: Final FEMM impact review remains a project gate.

materials_environment.note: P003/P007 316L controlled; exact screw/finish and O-ring compound open.

tolerance_dimensional_chains.note: Nominal ligaments pass; production tolerances/thermal stack still open.

manufacturability_process_capability.note: Round OD33 simplifies machining; M2.5 tapping in 316L and inspection capability need qualification.

assembly.note: C2 assembly passed, but C2R1 candidate/assembly must be rebuilt and verified; service-tool access also remains open.

serviceability.note: Removable architecture passes; galling/repeated-service procedure open.

inspection_testability.note: Released inspection plan and leak-test criteria are missing.

reliability_fmea.note: Loosening/thread/seal/service failure modes need FMEA disposition.

safety_regulatory_containment.note: Containment concept retained; leak/material compatibility evidence required.

supply_chain.note: Exact M2.5 screw and seal compound/supplier not frozen.

change_impact.note: C2 failure is preserved as rejection evidence and C2R1 is a separate controlled candidate; affected CAD/analysis/BOM/drawing/FEMM nodes are reopened.

documentation_traceability.note: C2 delta report, exact root-cause proof, EDR-019 and C2R1 controlled inputs are linked.

decision: Reject C2 as-built due proven P003↔P006 head interference. Continue OD33/M2.5 concept as Gate04D-C2R1 with pilot inner clearance ID12.00 study value.

C2_failure.root_cause: pilot ID10.917 overlaps P006 head OD11.5 over 1.50 mm
